name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: A dark left-hand navigation strip of icons that expands into a wider panel with labels when hovered, easing back to icons alone. It sits beside the page content.
use: A dashboard needs to save width but still let people read the menu labels on demand.
avoid: Labels only appear on hover, so touch users see icons alone, and the width jump reflows the page.
a11y: Collapsed links hide their text with display:none, leaving icon-only anchors unnamed, and the width change ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A narrow dark grey rail pinned to the left of a bordered panel, holding five small line icons in a vertical stack. Expanded, it widens into a slab and each icon gains a small grey label; the rest of the panel reads 'Main content area'.
behaves: Hovering the rail slides it open to show labels and pushes the content area aside; moving away shrinks it back to the icon strip. The width eases rather than snapping.
customise: Compose Sidebar, SidebarBody and SidebarLink with your own link objects, and control open state through Sidebar props. Widths, hover behaviour and colours are fixed in the file.
weight: light: A handful of links and one width animation; no loops or heavy assets.
